title: users/{uid}/cubes/{name}
description: A cube of an account's list of MAC addresses in Firestore, schema version 1 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §10, docs/PLAN.md T3.4): an entry of Settings → Cube MAC addresses, by the cube's Bluetooth name, which is the document's id. The account's, never the dataset's: no file of the dataset holds a MAC address.

name.description: The cube's Bluetooth name as Settings has it (such as GAN12ui_AB12), the document's id: not empty, without a slash, neither . nor .., and not __…__, as Firestore's ids must be. Settings matches names ignoring case.

mac.description: The cube's MAC address as Settings keeps it: six hex bytes in upper case with colons between them.

updatedMs.description: When the entry last changed, in ms, on the host clock of the device that changed it: of two copies of an entry, the one changed last wins a merge.

device.description: The host label of the device that wrote the document (Settings → This device; session.json's host.label).
